artDirection: Entirely new geometric editorial compositions. One coherent action or object per drawing, crisp perspective, substantial colour planes, controlled highlights, no diffuse glow or textured carrier.
themeTreatment: The former dark-mode palette and artwork are shared unchanged across light and dark themes. No theme overrides or colour filters.

stickers.title: A conversation across languages
stickers.idea: Two interlocking, angled speech bubbles; large custom German and Croatian glyphs, with no miniature interface.

stickers.title: Listen, learn, complete
stickers.idea: Headphones embrace one angled practice tile; a single large check is the focal point.

stickers.title: The Belot hand
stickers.idea: A newly drawn diagonal three-card hand, with crisp folds and a large club on the foreground card.

stickers.title: A winning Belot trick
stickers.idea: An angular split-colour club medallion with two small ribbon tails; one clear game symbol.

stickers.title: Pepper, ready to play
stickers.idea: A new three-quarter Pepper portrait with an elongated ceramic face, optical eyes and visible neck joint.

stickers.title: One precise deal
stickers.idea: A diagonal two-joint robot arm lifts a single diamond card. The mechanism has clear, plausible articulation.

stickers.title: Villa Bagara, in perspective
stickers.idea: An architectural cutout of a compact mountain house: pitched roof, shaded side wall and generous windows.

stickers.title: The mountain path
stickers.idea: A new asymmetric mountain silhouette with strong geological planes and one winding path through the foreground.

stickers.title: A family that branches
stickers.idea: Three anonymous people form one growing family shape; a branching stem connects generations without tiny portraits.

stickers.title: The guarded archive
stickers.idea: A private archive folder is guarded by one broad shield with a large keyhole, using clear overlapping planes.

stickers.title: A carefully written CV
stickers.idea: A new angled CV sheet with a strong editorial grid and a fountain pen crossing its edge. No tiny readable copy.

stickers.title: TeX, drawn as type
stickers.idea: A bespoke three-letter TeX composition with the lowered E, coloured cuts and generous negative space.

stickers.title: A website in motion
stickers.idea: A perspective browser canvas with two broad content blocks and a large cursor crossing its edge.

stickers.title: The working code studio
stickers.idea: A newly drawn perspective laptop with one bold code expression. The base and screen create a substantial silhouette.
